metadata.title: Pop Art Portrait with Neon Contours

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, screen-printed style portrait featuring a central figure with realistic skin tones overlaid with vibrant, neon-colored line art and geometric color blocks. The style emphasizes bold, hand-drawn contours in primary and secondary colors against a dark, textured background.
coreVisualRelationships: Realistic facial shading versus flat neon outlines
Geometric color blocks intersecting organic hair forms
Dark negative space framing high-saturation facial features
Hand-written script floating in the upper quadrant
coreInvariants: Neon red/pink contour lines defining facial features
Grainy, screen-printed texture across all surfaces
Offset color blocks that do not perfectly align with the subject
Deep black background with visible paper wear/creases

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale portrait occupying the central and lower-right two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eyes, emphasized by thick blue and purple neon outlines.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the bright yellow earring up through the face to the neon hair highlights, ending at the script in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black space in the lower left and upper right corners creates a diagonal tension.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black and warm tan skin tones provide the foundation.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Neon red, electric blue, and bright yellow serve as structural outlines.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mint green and magenta geometric blocks provide compositional balance.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast between the black background and the high-saturation neon accents.

letterConstructionRules: Variable line weight mimicking a felt-tip marker
Open counters and long, expressive terminals
characterSpecificRedesigns: Looping descenders that merge into the next character
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: The organic script contrasts with the geometric blocks and sharp neon outlines of the portrait.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the raw, expressive energy of the pop art style.
Aligns with the era-specific aesthetic of the visual.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast portrait of a woman with warm skin tones, featuring neon red outlines on her face, electric blue eye makeup, and a large afro with magenta and blue highlights. Include a mint green geometric block at the bottom and a dark brown block behind the head. The background should be textured black with subtle paper creases.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a white, hand-written marker script in the top right corner, tilted slightly upwards, using a fluid and expressive cursive style.

verificationChecks: Are the neon outlines vibrant and distinct from the skin shading?
Is the background a deep, textured black?
Does the script look hand-drawn rather than typeset?
Are the geometric color blocks present and slightly misaligned?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure neon lines follow facial contours accurately.
Verify the white script is legible against the dark background.
Check that the texture feels like physical print media.
Confirm the composition maintains the diagonal tension.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a realistic shaded portrait with neon wireframe contours, offset geometric color fields, and a textured black background, topped with a white marker-style signature.
